hypothesis.claim: A promoted prefill/recompute must reserve service before decode when mixed batching is enabled and its rank outranks decode.
hypothesis.trigger: valid authored ScenarioConfig with mixed_phase_batching true, max token budget 1, low-priority active decode, high-priority prompt arrival
hypothesis.expected_baseline: mixed path consumes every token on decode before checking promoted prefill, delaying high-priority request
hypothesis.observed: parent control delayed request b by 360ns; candidate reserves promoted non-decode first and matches non-mixed priority timing
hypothesis.falsifier: no-promotion decode-first controls change, or promotion path remains delayed after fix

activation_checks: serve_non_decode rank promotion is computed before mixed branch
promoted prefill/recompute is admitted before constructing decode cohort
remaining token/sequence budget can still be filled with decode
no-promotion existing mixed decode-first path remains unchanged
high-priority first-token and finish times match non-mixed control
